label: EdgeSwitch 8 PoE
description: EdgeSwitch 8 PoE (ES-8-150W) - 8x 1G RJ45 (all PoE/PoE+, 24V passive on the same pairs) + 2x 1G SFP, serial console. 150 W total PoE availability; 20 Gbps switching capacity.

poe.note: Ubiquiti states the allocation in words, so this is a published figure rather than the model-name parse it used to be. The archived store page's key features read "(8) GbE RJ45 ports with 24V passive PoE / (2) SFP ports / 150W total PoE availability / Desktop-mountable", and its spec table (the live page prints the same Port/PoE rows but no Management row) reads "PoE interface: (8) PoE/PoE+ 2-pair (+1, 2; -3, 6); (8) 24V/0.7A 2-pair (+4, 5; -7, 8)", "Max. power consumption: 20W (Excludes PoE output)", "Power supply: Internal AC/DC 150W", "Operating voltage: 100-240V AC, 50-60Hz; 42-56V DC". Recorded caveat: 150 W of availability beside a 20 W excluding-PoE draw and a 150 W supply leaves no headroom, and the vendor publishes no including/excluding split for the PoE figure itself, so 150 W is modelled because Ubiquiti states it as availability, not because it was derived here.

notes:
Census from the archived Ubiquiti storefront (https://web.archive.org/web/20240906195421id_/https://store.ui.com/us/en/products/es-8-150w, HTTP 200, 20,742 B gzip / 124,166 B decoded, capture 2024-09-06). That capture is the surface that still carries the full table: Networking interface "(8) 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 ports; (2) 1 Gbps SFP ports"; Management interface "Ethernet In-Band, UART console Out-of-Band"; PoE interface "(8) PoE/PoE+ 2-pair (+1, 2; -3, 6); (8) 24V/0.7A 2-pair (+4, 5; -7, 8)"; Power supply "Internal AC/DC 150W"; Operating voltage "100-240V AC, 50-60Hz; 42-56V DC"; Max. power consumption "20W (Excludes PoE output)". The live tech-spec page (https://techspecs.ui.com/uisp/wired/es-8-150w, HTTP 200, 583,247 B, read 2026-11-20) prints the Networking and PoE rows and a power block, but **no Management interface row at all** and, like its 16-port sibling, no "Total PoE available" row - so the console and the budget are cited to the archived page, not to the live one.

Census correction: this spec declared the eight copper ports and the two cages but not the out-of-band console the vendor row names, so the console is added here - 11 jacks, matching the archived table.
